detail.title: Project Manager (PMO) - Akila, Remote, USA
detail.jobDescription:
Mission 
                                
Akila is looking for a Project Manager for the deployment of Akila solution in the US as we rapidly scale there. You will work in a multidisciplinary team and an international environment, handling customer relationships for as long as the client uses the platform. You will lead a cross functional project team, from kick-off to end of roll-out, working closely with our US partner ecosystem including during the commercial process.

Candidate will have great communication and relationship management skills; demonstrate rigor to drive projects to meet all the project requirements (client satisfaction, planification, quality of the delivery, budget). Must be comfortable in a startup environment where speed, hard work and fresh thinking are critical to success.
                            
                            
                                
                                    
Key Responsibilities 
                                    
- Take ownership of the customer relationship from project kick-off and for as long as the client uses the platform

- Communicate proactively with the client on its satisfaction, identify new requirements and opportunities or dissatisfaction and churn risk.

- Drive deployment projects from project kick-off till the “go live” with a high level of rigor and professionalism.

- Support the customer in its operational objectives definition and coordinate the cross-functional team to achieve it.

- Ensure client satisfaction as a top priority.

- Deliver best quality deliverables on-time within the budget.

- Document the project internally.

- Define the project KPI’s and measure the project performance.

-Support our partner’s ecosystem locally including as a solution expert during the commercial phase.
                                
                                
                                    
Key Skills 
                                    
- Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

- Good verbal and written English proficiency.

- At least 3 years working in a similar position. Previous Product-focused Startup experience

- Ability to work both as a team leader and as an individual contributor, including occasionally writing and reviewing code.

- Strong technical knowledge of large-scale software development, design, and architecture

- Impressive problem-solving, leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with an ability to work in a metrics-based, fast-paced, and dynamic team environment.

- Experience delivering large-scale mobile and/or cloud apps Extra Bonus

- Experience managing a team of 20+ engineers & experience working with distributed development teams.

- Experience in backend/frontend development in AI, Java & JavaScript
